Comparing x and z, x has a value of $71 and z has a value of $62. Thus, I prefer x over z.

Now I need to decide how to rank all four. I will likely get w or y, so I should rank my favorite of those two highest. I prefer w ($61) to y ($52), so w should be ranked first. However, x is my highest value school ($71), so I should rank it second in case I get lucky. Next should be z, since I prefer z ($62) to y ($52). Finally, y.
